name: Smokeping
tagline: Free open source network performance monitoring tool
description: keeps track of your network latency.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  smokeping:
    environment:
      PGID: "1000"
      PUID: "1000"
      TZ: Europe/London
    image: linuxserver/smokeping:2.9.0
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: 64M
    network_mode: bridge
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /data
    container_name: smokeping
